title: Ethiopian-Style Lentil Stew with Flatbread
description: A hearty and flavorful Ethiopian-inspired stew made with lentils, served with a side of crispy flatbread.
instructions: Heat the niter kibbeh in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the lentils, vegetable broth, and spices. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
While the stew is cooking, prepare the flatbread according to package instructions or recipe.
To serve, place a portion of the stew on a flatbread, then top with additional spices or garnishes as desired.
